genotype_representation: formal int8 ALT dosage; -1 is missing; 0/1/2 are diploid ALT dosages

kernel.centering: Z_ij = dosage_ij - 2p_j, with p_j estimated on the exact fit partition
kernel.missing: replace a missing dosage by its fit-partition mean before centering; equivalently its centered contribution is zero
kernel.normalization: denominator is recomputed from exactly the selected fit-partition COMMON markers for every density and every inner/outer fit
kernel.density_comparability: alpha is independently inner-tuned for every density; no alpha is shared across densities

density.selection: filter the frozen physical-bin rank to fit-partition COMMON eligibility, then take the prefix; COMMON_250K is nested in COMMON_ALL
density.unavailable: If fewer than requested K fit-partition COMMON markers exist, emit unavailable rather than cap.

hyperparameter_selection.objective: sum of squared validation errors pooled over all inner held-out accessions
hyperparameter_selection.boundary_extension: If the selected alpha is at either initial-grid boundary, extend that boundary by four 0.5-log10 steps, refit all inner candidates, and repeat until the optimum is interior or a hard cap is reached.
hyperparameter_selection.tie_break: smallest alpha among exactly equal pooled inner SSE values
hyperparameter_selection.budget: The same inner folds, alpha procedure and failure policy apply to every available density.

numerics.solver: Cholesky solve of K + alpha I
numerics.jitter: none after successful Cholesky; on failure add lambda*I, lambda = 1e-10*trace(K)/n and multiply by 10 until success or lambda exceeds 1e-4*trace(K)/n
numerics.failure_policy: If the hard jitter cap fails, mark this fit/density unavailable; do not substitute a different solver or silently drop samples.

validation.dense_primal_parity: A fixed synthetic fixture must agree with the dense primal ridge solution for the exact kernel convention.
validation.standard_implementation_parity: Before interpreting G1 results, compare an intermediate marker subset with a documented standard GBLUP/rrBLUP-equivalent implementation under the same centering and normalization.
